authorization: User explicitly allowed official read-only Cloudflare API for Workers Free/Paid classification and lie-game effective CPU limit only; no setting, subscription, permission or traffic changes.

authentication.adapter: Cloudflare official connector, internally authenticated OAuth

workerContext.confirmation: Existing cf CLI deployments list and workers get, same account/worker selection; settings response does not itself identify a version, so this context is not an atomic settings/version snapshot.

settings.schemaSource: Cloudflare official OpenAPI via connector search: GET /accounts/{account_id}/workers/scripts/{script_name}/settings
settings.schemaCpuField: limits.cpu_ms: integer, CPU time in milliseconds

entitlements.schemaSource: Cloudflare official OpenAPI: GET /accounts/{account_id}/entitlements; feature.key and allocation.type/value
entitlements.projection: Only Workers CPU/plan/Free/Paid/standard/unbound/execution entitlement keys and allocations

subscription.schemaSource: Cloudflare official OpenAPI: GET /accounts/{account_id}/subscriptions; plan identity and state only, no bill/payment endpoints
subscription.projection: Workers Free/Paid classification only; monetary, billing, payment and other-product values excluded inside connector
subscription.fixedErrorCategory: OAuth connection cannot use endpoint; API token with Billing Read or Billing Write required

conclusion.nextFactSource: Workers & Pages Dashboard: Workers subscription Free/Paid and lie-game CPU time limit; do not confuse with domain Free/Pro plan
